diagnosis: The endpoint uses a parameterized class dependency RequireRole to restrict access to users with the 'dept_manager' or 'finance_director' role. However, it fails to perform an object-level authorization check ensuring that the authenticated manager actually manages dept_id. A manager from one department can arbitrarily reconfigure the budget allocations of any other department.
exploit_request:
PUT /departments/18/budget-cap HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <manager_dept_4_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"annual_budget_cap": 2500000}
